Run was slow rig was slow 
We all worked together and safely
Good team work job went smooth everyone looked out for each other and worked together to get the job done safely , no injuries no near misses
Job went successfully with out injury or incident
During the connection of the third or fourth joint, the hoist line supporting the power tongs became entangled with the rig's service lines while retracting to secure the tongs.
Crew did an awesome job while changing out dies on the CDS tool.
License plate on truck unit #2334, numbers are coming off the license plate. Please see attachment.
While conducting field visit, noticed utility trailer had back taillight broken. Please see attachment
Floor is covered in oil base and hoses ran across floor.
Had snub line clamps on wrong
